in_sanskrit.name: जयिता
in_sanskrit.meaning: विजयी विघ्नराहिनी (विजयी = विजयी शक्ति, विघ्नराहिनी = सहस्यात्मक)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who removes obstacles and bestows victory (Jayanti = having the power of victory, Vighnarahini = having the power to remove obstacles)

in_tamil.name: ஜயிதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: விஜயம் அக்கிரம் உடன் வரும் (Vijayam Agram Udanam)

in_marathi.name: Jayita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jayita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jay' meaning victory or triumph. It is a name of great significance in Hindu mythology and culture, representing the triumph of good over evil and the victory of the human spirit.
